issuing_body: Minnesota Judicial Branch / Ramsey County District Court
title: Feeding Our Future v. Minnesota Department of Education: Correcting Media Reports and Statements by Governor Tim Walz Concerning Orders Issued by the Court
supports: The original November 2020 civil lawsuit concerned MDE's handling of applications for new food-distribution sites and race-discrimination claims; a December 22, 2020 consent order required site applications to be handled reasonably promptly.
The Judicial Branch states Judge John Guthmann never ordered MDE to resume Feeding Our Future reimbursement payments in April 2021 or at any other time.
The Judicial Branch states MDE voluntarily resumed payments and later asked the court to deny Feeding Our Future's nonpayment-sanctions motion as moot because MDE had resumed payments voluntarily.
The Judicial Branch states MDE advised the court that Feeding Our Future's serious deficiencies were resolved as of June 4, 2021.
The Judicial Branch states all MDE food-reimbursement payments to Feeding Our Future were made voluntarily, without any court order requiring payment.
contradiction_target: Public/media/official claims that Judge Guthmann ordered MDE to resume or continue Feeding Our Future reimbursements in April 2021.
does_not_support: The correction does not say MDE was legally free of all constraints in its treatment of Feeding Our Future; the civil litigation involved application-processing obligations and other disputes.
The fact that payment resumption was voluntary does not by itself establish criminal intent, corruption, or knowledge of the full later-charged scheme.
This record does not establish why every individual MDE payment decision was made; it resolves the specific claim that the court ordered reimbursement payments resumed.
